observations.behavior: Adds a dedicated ThreadPoolExecutor and a nested executor, and wires them into the warehouse load consumer.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion uses asyncio and calls into blocking I/O; this could prevent thread starvation and deadlock when nested jobs share the loop's default executor.

observations.behavior: Adds a command-line argument and a helper to size the nested thread pool, with startup failure if the override is too small.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion operators to tune the nested thread pool size, while retaining a safety check against undersized configurations.

observations.behavior: Adds a new module defining thread pool sizing and two named thread pools, with a dedicated error for undersized nested pools.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a shared, typed configuration and a dedicated error type for warehouse ingestion, supporting consistent sizing and failure handling.
